context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the identify-risks instructions from the published agnostic-planning-skills tile.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Scan plans for risks backed by concrete evidence — not speculation.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: DO NOT fabricate risks. Every risk MUST reference a specific task or requirement.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Scan risk patterns** (see Risk Patterns below) — dependency chains, external deps, ambiguity, single points of failure, capacity, technical uncertainty.

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Classify** — Likelihood (High/Medium/Low), Impact (High/Medium/Low), Proximity (Immediate/Near-term/Future).

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Verify likelihood/impact ratings are justified by evidence
